Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000930" [decision]: As of 2025-12-18, the Boreal team has adopted a weekly dependency update day.  (about: Boreal team)
- memory_id "1000907": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000904": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000900": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team noticed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000886": As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team, having left Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000808": On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000804" [decision]: On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team decided that webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000791": On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000780" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000776": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000773" [decision]: As of 2025-10-07, reindex jobs will page on failure.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000771": In INC-2025-023, the indexer served stale results for two days starting 2025-10-03 because a reindex job failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000767": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000661" [decision]: On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000352" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000343": The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, job scheduler, billing API, Cinder, Diego, Ember team, notification service, webhook dispatcher, Atlas team, image resizer, ledger service, indexer, the bus, reporting service, feature-flags, OpenSearch 2.11, product catalog
